scope.description: An optional compositional direction for a user-requested abstract painting built around an open center. Let an incomplete ring or broad arc hold a quiet unpainted or lightly painted interior while uneven clusters of lines and geometric marks create pressure around its perimeter. The orbit is an abstract structure, not a planet, target, clock, or fixed diagram.
limitations: Use only when the user requests an abstract composition organized around a quiet center or incomplete ring.
Preserve requested colors, shapes, aspect ratio, and mark density.
Keep the center open; do not turn it into a planet, eye, clock, or target unless the user asks.
Do not copy a named work or reuse the geometry of a supplied reference composition.

rules.applies_when: The user requests an abstract composition with an open center or incomplete circular structure.
rules.instruction: Use one incomplete ring or broad arc to frame a quiet center; keep the opening visibly broken and avoid filling the center with a dominant form.
rules.observable: A legible open interior contrasts with an off-center arc and surrounding marks.
rules.reject_when: The ring closes into a target or the center becomes the densest part of the image.
rules.avoid: perfect concentric circles, target symbols, or literal planetary orbits

rules.instruction: Distribute a few geometric masses, thin lines, and small color marks unevenly around the arc so one side carries greater weight and another stays sparse.
rules.observable: The ring feels active but not mechanically tiled, with the quiet center remaining distinct.
rules.reject_when: Marks repeat at equal intervals or the layout becomes a symmetric mandala.
rules.avoid: uniform radial spokes, symmetry, or decorative border patterns

rules.applies_when: Geometric marks and arcs define the abstract structure.
rules.instruction: Vary edge precision, line weight, and pigment density slightly; retain a tactile painted ground beneath the shapes.
rules.observable: The arrangement reads as a resolved painting rather than a vector infographic.
rules.reject_when: Every edge, stroke, and interval becomes perfectly uniform.
rules.avoid: glossy gradients, 3D spheres, or explanatory labels
